statement: The record confirms Saturday at 08:30 for brake pads and discs at Fairview Motors, but it names the sold blue Vauxhall, so I’ll book the grey Honda instead.
judge_text:
WRONG

"it names the sold blue Vauxhall, so I'll book the grey Honda instead" — asserts the record's car is the wrong, already-sold vehicle and supplies the correct one.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
